items.name: Bigtopa — multi-tenant platform backend
description: Multi-tenant backend for chat, spaces/rooms, DMs, meetings, blogs, and project tooling: tenant-scoped data, Cognito auth, and AppSync pipeline resolvers.
Event-driven notifications via EventBridge → Lambda → external notification service and Pusher, including in-app, web-push, and meeting-specific flows.
Stack: TypeScript, AWS CDK (IaC), MongoDB/Mongoose, Lambda behind AppSync.

items.name: Doerfy — GraphQL monorepo backend
description: Designed and maintained a monorepo GraphQL backend using GraphQL Yoga, TypeGraphQL, and Express, exposing a single /graphql endpoint.
Schema-first resolvers across 50+ feature domains: tasks, goals, stories, collaboration, content, subscriptions, notifications, admin, and more.

items.name: Blending101 — Blending Recipe
description: Blending Recipe is a Node.js GraphQL API for a nutrition and recipe platform: recipes, ingredients, nutrients, member content, planning, and related CMS-style features, backed by MongoDB and exposed over Apollo / type-graphql.

responsibilities: Doerfy (dev.doerfy.com): Designed and maintained a monorepo GraphQL backend using GraphQL Yoga, TypeGraphQL, and Express — single /graphql endpoint with schema-first resolvers across 50+ domains (tasks, goals, stories, collaboration, content, subscriptions, notifications, admin, and more).

Blending101 / Blending Recipe (app.blending101.com): Blending Recipe is a Node.js GraphQL API for a nutrition and recipe platform: recipes, ingredients, nutrients, member content, planning, and related CMS-style features, backed by MongoDB and exposed over Apollo / type-graphql.

Bigtopa (app.bigtopa.com): Built and maintained a multi-tenant backend (tenant-scoped data, Cognito auth, AppSync pipeline resolvers) for chat, spaces/rooms, DMs, meetings, blogs, and project tooling.
